ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(FundingTier__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(NOARecevied__c, "No"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Review")) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IVF_Application', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IVF_Application_Read_Only' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only select or change a funding tier if the application is ‘In Review’ and NoA has been received.
